flow: National packaged-foods brand with a fragmented distribution network. Replaced 6 legacy tools with one platform, with change-management that actually worked.
Sales ops ran on 6 disconnected systems per region. Distributor onboarding was a 90-day project. Leadership estimated a 2-year rollout for any unified platform.
Phased rollout: 50 pilot distributors in week 2, then 3 regions per fortnight. Standard 30-minute onboarding flow for each distributor. Train-the-trainer model with regional leads.
1,400 distributors live in 8 weeks. Coverage up 22% from improved beat-plan execution. 6 legacy tools sunset within the first quarter.
